query: What policy levers (NIA disclosure, funding-criteria shifts, narrative audits) most effectively reduce expectation-driven risky prioritization in field pilots or simulated interventions?

response.query: What policy levers (NIA disclosure, funding-criteria shifts, narrative audits) most effectively reduce expectation-driven risky prioritization in field pilots or simulated interventions?
response.answer: NIA disclosure and funding-criteria shifts most effectively reduce expectation-driven risky prioritization in field pilots. Narrative audits provide additional oversight.
